name: observability
_comment_kustomization: H-9: intentionally NO 'kustomization' entry, so add/remove NEVER wire observability into k8s/base. The base 'namespace: vibecarbon' transformer would override the child namespace and ship the stack UN-isolated on every deploy path (the forge vuln we fix). The direct k3s deploy applies it as a SEPARATE isolated kustomization into vibecarbon-observability (applyK3sManifests). The gitops/Flux deploy reconciles only k8s/base, so it does NOT deploy observability yet — deployK8sGitOps emits a loud warning; isolation on gitops is a tracked follow-up (the Flux Kustomization).
